Shipping on Fridays

Most teams freeze deploys on Fridays because they fear weekend incidents. We argue the opposite: if you cannot deploy safely on a Friday, you cannot deploy safely at all.

Over two years we shipped 1,200 Friday deploys. Only three caused an incident, all rolled back automatically within five minutes thanks to canary analysis.

The key ingredients are small changes, feature flags, automated rollback and good observability. Without these, the day of the week does not matter.

We recommend measuring change failure rate per weekday before adopting a freeze policy.
